range_status: Controlled experimental ranges, not an inferred galaxy population. Opening range includes the 40-deg outer half-angle literature benchmark; inclination is restricted so sightlines remain outside the cone. PA spans the undirected axis. Other ranges vary the existing illustrative scenario. New dust, texture and host/H II amplitude ranges are illustrative controlled-test ranges, not measured astrophysical priors. Dust correlation sigma is not a cloud radius. Relative amplitudes inherit gas-p99 and global empirical scaling.
limitations: Prescribed geometry with simulated emission; not a 3D transfer solution
Shared older CLOUDY grids and observational calibration limit generalization claims
Smooth control is analytic, not a CLOUDY-rendered galaxy
Variants of one realization stay in the same data split
negative_definition: One matched cone_free image per realization: subtract all saved post-PSF cone-associated light, including off-axis tails, at fixed empirical amplitude. Retain host/H II/stellar/nuclear emission, baseline and the same noise. This is a counterfactual removal control, not an inactive-galaxy population.
measurement_policy: No messiness input parameter. Measure linear post-PSF C/B in whole and nominal-cone annuli, structure at stated scales, foreground-screen coverage/transmission, resolution and per-pixel signal/noise. Provisional categories are descriptive, not a validated difficulty score.
